mapper.insert: insert into reconcile_case( case_no, biz_type, biz_id, user_id, case_type, case_status, severity, source_status, target_status, summary, detail, retry_count, create_time, update_time ) values( #{caseNo}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{userId}, #{caseType}, #{caseStatus}, #{severity}, #{sourceStatus}, #{targetStatus}, #{summary}, #{detail}, #{retryCount}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update source_status = values(source_status), target_status = values(target_status), summary = values(summary), detail = values(detail), retry_count = if(case_status in (1, 2, 3), retry_count, retry_count + 1), case_status = if(case_status in (1, 2, 3), case_status, values(case_status)), update_time = if(case_status in (1, 2, 3), update_time, now())
mapper.select: select id, case_no, biz_type, biz_id, user_id, case_type, case_status, severity, source_status, target_status, summary, detail, retry_count, create_time, update_time, handled_time, handler, handle_note from reconcile_case where case_no = #{caseNo} limit 1
mapper.update: update reconcile_case set case_status = #{caseStatus}, handler = #{handler}, handle_note = #{handleNote}, handled_time = now(), update_time = now() where case_no = #{caseNo} and case_status = 0
update reconcile_case set handler = #{handler}, handle_note = #{handleNote}, update_time = now() where case_no = #{caseNo}
mapper.select:
select count(1) from reconcile_case where case_status = 0
and case_type = #{caseType}

select count(1) from reconcile_case where case_status = 0 and ( (severity = 'critical' and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 15 minute)) or (severity <> 'critical' and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 2 hour)) )
